svg.title: Patchify and raster order
svg.desc: A 224 by 224 image with P = 32 becomes a 7 by 7 grid of patches, read row by row into a sequence of 49 patch tokens.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the image into P × P patches and read them in raster order
